summary: open() writes and reads text files so data lasts after the program ends. Use a with block so the file is always closed.
notes: "w" erases the file first. "a" adds to the end.
Each line read from a file ends with \n. line.strip() removes it before you split.
Values read from a file are strings, so int(score) converts them before adding.
pitfall: Opening with "w" when you meant "a" erases everything already in the file, with no error message.
